items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: And the Colonel of the 816th is going to be Colonel L.A. I. Chapman.

ctx.x: Oh, they were fine. We dated them down in Clovis, New Mexico one time. But that's either here or there. Anyhow, this fellow was already in his first lieutenant's uniform. And they had sent him to take charge of the 816th Pioneer Infantry Band. He held a rehearsal with we twenty-four fellas. And he says, I'll have another rehearsal tonight at nine o'clock. This is long, about six o'clock. That night at nine o'clock, we were all assembled in there again. He says, I'm going to have an elimination contest in here. He…
